privacyPanel.title: Privacy & AI Controls
privacyPanel.subtitle: Control how your data is processed and which AI features are enabled
privacyPanel.privacyNotice: All processing happens in your browser. No transaction data is uploaded to servers. AI features are opt-in and only send cleaned transaction descriptions (no account numbers, names, or addresses) when enabled.
privacyPanel.aiFeaturesDescription: Enable AI Features powered by OpenAI for advanced functionality. When disabled, all AI-dependent features are automatically disabled.
privacyPanel.whatsSentDescription: Only cleaned transaction descriptions (e.g., "AMAZON.COM"). No account numbers, names, or addresses. Powered by OpenAI GPT-4o-mini.
privacyPanel.smartDuplicateDetectionDescription: Use AI to detect duplicate transactions even when merchant names differ (e.g., 'AMAZON PRIME' vs 'AMZN MKTP CA')
privacyPanel.anomalyDetectionDescription: Flag unusual spending patterns (e.g., 'Your Starbucks purchase of $85 is unusual')
privacyPanel.predictiveSpendingDescription: Forecast monthly spending by category using AI analysis
privacyPanel.naturalLanguageImportDescription: Auto-configure bank imports using natural language (e.g., 'Import my TD checking account CSV')
privacyPanel.chatbotDescription: AI-powered assistant that can answer questions about your transactions, budgets, and spending patterns. Conversations are processed via OpenAI API.
privacyPanel.chatbotPrivacyNotice: Your financial data is sent to OpenAI to answer questions. OpenAI does not use API data to train models. You can disable anytime.
privacyPanel.readOnlyDescription: Chatbot can view data and answer questions but cannot modify anything
privacyPanel.fullAccessDescription: Chatbot can perform actions like adding transactions and creating budgets
privacyPanel.conversationStorageNotice: Conversations are stored locally in your browser. You can manually delete them anytime.
privacyPanel.enableAnalyticsDescription: Track feature usage and app performance using PostHog. No personal financial data (amounts, descriptions) is collected.
privacyPanel.enableErrorTrackingDescription: Automatically report errors and crashes to Sentry to help improve the app. No financial data is included in error reports.
privacyPanel.receiptOCRDescription: Extract transaction details from receipt images using client-side OCR (Tesseract.js). No data leaves your device.
privacyPanel.encryptStoredDataDescription: Encrypt sensitive transaction data at rest using AES-GCM encryption. Requires key generation on first enable.
privacyPanel.encryptionNotAvailable: Encryption is not available in this browser. Please use a modern browser with Web Crypto API support.
privacyPanel.encryptionFailed: Failed to enable encryption. Please try again.
privacyPanel.encryptionActive: Encryption is active. Your data is encrypted in IndexedDB.
